_meta.title: Migrants who died or went missing on migration routes (IOM Missing Migrants Project)
_meta.what: Each point is one recorded incident in which people on the move died or disappeared while migrating (drowning, vehicle accidents, violence, harsh conditions, lack of shelter or medical care), at or near borders and along routes, worldwide since 2014. Counts are minimums.
_meta.licence: CC BY 4.0 ("The downloads above are licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License")
_meta.citation: IOM's Missing Migrants Project, https://missingmigrants.iom.int (data downloaded 2026-10-21).
_meta.precision_note: precision "exact" means the coordinates come from the source; IOM notes many locations are approximate (e.g. sea crossings, medical examiner jurisdictions).
_meta.source_quality_note: IOM source-quality score 1 (single unverified source) to 5 (official/forensic record).
_meta.live: No: the CSV is served without an Access-Control-Allow-Origin header.

coord_check.method: Each point tested against the Natural Earth 1:50m polygon of its Country of Incident with a 0.5 degree buffer. "swapped_in_country" = the source coordinates are outside the country but swapping latitude and longitude puts the point inside it (likely an entry error in the source). "outside_country" includes sea incidents attributed to a coastal country. Coordinates are left exactly as IOM publishes them.

_meta.compact_note: rows are arrays in the order of "columns"; source_url for every row is https://missingmigrants.iom.int/downloads
_meta.spread_note: Where IOM gives one point for 3 or more incidents that name only a district, county or province, they are spread evenly inside the OpenStreetMap outline of the area containing IOM's point (Nominatim reverse lookup); IOM's own point is kept in source_lat/source_lon.
